implementation.dashboard: Four primary cards: Cash/Bank closing, Custody closing receivable, selected-period operating/Project GL costs, selected-month unposted review count
implementation.middle: Six-month canonical funding/payments/expense chart and actionable Needs Attention panel. Overlapping flags never summed; undated count explicitly all-period. Owner funding never revenue.
implementation.recent: At most five posted journals from the selected month; exact balanced journal value and recognized Treasury/Custody account. Read-only specific-record drawer links to filtered journal report and original canonical workspace. Unknown/incomplete enrichment withheld.
implementation.full_reports: Existing /accounting-reports?view=transactions now hosts previous comprehensive monthly report, filters, server pagination, Company/Project scope and Excel/PDF. Existing /accounting-reports landing and /accounting-cycle audit/provenance preserved.
implementation.responsive: Actual CompanyWorkspaceShell/branding/sidebar retained; duplicate Dashboard page header removed; FULL access notice compacted, all LIMITED/unknown warnings preserved. Numeric month picker, RTL/LTR, desktop table and mobile readable recent rows.
implementation.boundaries: No financial engine, mutation command, schema, RLS, permission or authentication changes. No new ERP module.

limitations: Product Owner visual acceptance and publication remain pending; local verification is not a claim of deployed acceptance.
Recent amounts show journal value; unrecognized funding directs the user to original documents rather than guessing.
Large journal enrichment is bounded to20 reads and roughly200 lines; incomplete values are withheld and full canonical reports remain available.
Outstanding Maker evidence completion, historical payroll and operational acceptance remain separate.
Original commercial ERP roadmap and deferred restore/USB tasks preserved.
